description: Call this when you tried to do something for your user and could not finish it: there is no API for the action, a CAPTCHA or bot check stopped you, it needs a login or account, it is phone-only or in person only, or a booking or government portal blocks automation. Examples: booking, submitting a form, contacting a business, filing with a portal, sending post. Returns any existing route that already handles it, plus a log id. Requests are pooled and the most requested actions get built. Free, no key.

description.description: The action you were trying to take

failure_type.description: Why it failed: no_api, captcha, login_required, bot_blocked, phone_only, human_verification, payment, other

max_price_usd.description: Most you (or your operator) would pay per request in USD if this existed, e.g. 0.01

private.description: Set true to have your description, purpose and error text used for matching but not stored

purpose.description: What the user wanted to achieve

name: request_action
title: Request an action you could not complete
